meta.description: Turns paths, geometry and instances into one geometry, for example to place a whole umbel with its flowers with an instance node. With variants on, every stem becomes its own geometry.

input.description: The paths, geometry and instances to bake into one geometry.

max_circle_segments.description: The most segments around a baked path, lower it for small parts. 0 uses the circle resolution setting.

max_points.description: The most points along a baked path, longer paths are resampled to this many. 0 keeps all points.

variants.description: Bake every stem of the input into its own geometry, with the paths and instances that grow on it, and give them as a list. Every stem draws its own random values, so an instance node can pick a different variant for every instance.
